prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic full-body fashion lookbook portrait of one original approved adult woman in a bright minimalist white interior.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with soft blonde hair in loose voluminous waves, luminous natural skin texture, delicate facial features and a calm confident expression. She wears the supplied fitted strapless pastel-pink denim mini dress with corset-style lace-up front, layered silver necklaces, supplied metallic watch, pink-red monogram tote and white strapped heels.
composition_elements: Full-body standing portrait against a white wall corner; create one frontal and one over-shoulder variant while preserving the supplied outfit and accessories.
Bright even editorial lighting, clean neutral walls and minimal floor detail.
Preserve bag pattern only as supplied, dress raw hem and lacing, jewelry, watch, heels and natural skin.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright large-source softbox or window light with even exposure, soft corner shadows, gentle pastel reflections and clean high-fashion atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 50mm lens at f/5.6, sharp full-body clothing and accessory detail, natural skin pores, subtle grain, clean color grade, no invented text or watermark.
